summary: The master of construction! Relax & Chill simulation game.
description:
This addictive mobile game lets you demolish buildings, complete construction phases, and sell your finished structures - all simulation with just one finger on the screen.

Not only can you build buildings, but you can also create other structures such as farms, pools, and parking lots, and then sell them for profit. With a variety of construction projects to tackle, you'll need to be strategic in managing your simulation time. Manage resources to become the ultimate property tycoon.

So get ready to put your building skills to the test. Start demolishing and constructing your way to success in the construction game!

Sing our song with us while playing the game.

- Toolin' Around -
Hammering and sawing all day long
Building a home to keep us strong
Drilling and digging in the ground
Laying foundations all around

We build, we grow
With every tool we know
Our work, our pride
With every nail we drive

Welding and painting, making it right
Putting together with all our might
Measuring twice, cutting it once
Making it perfect, never a dunce

We build, we grow
With every sim we know
Our work, our pride
With every sim we drive

We wish you pleasant simulation games :)

IGRS rating: 13+
